annotation.evidence_span: A receiver MUST treat the receipt of any other type of frame or a frame on a different stream as a connection error of type PROTOCOL_ERROR.
annotation.interpretation_a: Any frame that isn't a PUSH_PROMISE frame, or any frame on a stream other than the one the PUSH_PROMISE was sent on, is a PROTOCOL_ERROR.
annotation.interpretation_b: If a PUSH_PROMISE is sent, *all* other frames, regardless of stream, are considered errors. This could lead to premature connection termination if other valid frames are sent concurrently.
annotation.justification: The clause doesn't specify the scope of the error condition. Does it apply to all frames, or only those related to the stream the PUSH_PROMISE was sent on? This ambiguity could lead to different implementations and interoperability issues.
annotation.missing_information: It is unclear if the error condition applies to all frames, or only those related to the same stream as the PUSH_PROMISE. The phrase 'a frame on a different stream' could be interpreted as *any* different stream, or only streams that are not part of the same logical exchange.
